title: Mechanistic insights into the (3 + 2) cycloaddition of azomethine ylide with dimethyl acetylenedicarboxylate via bond evolution theory
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29666-29679
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04992J, Paper
Open Access

Mohamed Chellegui, Raghad Mowafak Al-Mokhtar, Raad Nasrullah Salih, Lakhdar Benhamed, Sofiane Benmetir, Jesus Vicente de Julián-Ortiz, Haydar A. Mohammad-Salim, Ali Ben Ahmed
DFT at the B3LYP-D3/6-311++G(d,p) level reveals a polar, asynchronous, multistage 32CA mechanism between azomethine ylide and dimethyl acetylenedicarboxylate, with kinetic preference for formation of the exo cycloadduct.
